coordinate_set: the frozen radius-4 GRID from z5_projective_leg_bivariate_mc.py

estimators.current: the production translated_points(field_seed, replica) anchor on the same counter-based replica
estimators.independent: one uniform parent anchor from a separately seeded SplitMix64 counter
estimators.full: the exact arithmetic mean over all 101 parent anchors for the same configuration

pairing: all three estimators share each Bernoulli configuration, both children, both charges and the runner gauge
primary: per estimator and hand/charge, compare raw and frozen CRT-mask-times-positive-Fourier-cone distances using its own batch covariance
paired_differences: covariance-whitened zero-mean tests for current-independent, current-full and independent-full; retain batch rows for the full cross-estimator/channel covariance

decision.sampling_or_counter_correlation: full-anchor cone survives while a one-anchor cone rejects, with a resolved paired discrepancy; a current-only excess over independent indicates counter coupling
decision.scorer_or_model_assembly: full-anchor cone rejects comparably, because anchor sampling has been removed
decision.underpowered: the channels disagree or paired covariance does not resolve the estimator differences

historical_control: aggregate every four new current batches and reproduce the first 25 radius-4 production batches from the identical seed/replica interval
claim_boundary: one authorized 5k paired pilot only; no new observable, geometry, field interpretation or production extension
